aoi.name: Brahmaputra-Jamuna Floodplain & Char Lands (Sirajganj / Bogura / Jamalpur)
aoi.description: Braided river floodplain and dynamic sandbars (chars) with strong monsoon flood expansion and bank migration.

aoi.name: Haor Basin (Sylhet & Sunamganj Tectonic Wetlands)
aoi.description: Bowl-shaped tectonic depressions (haors) that transform into a vast inland sea during the monsoon and drain in the dry season for Boro rice cultivation.

aoi.name: Chattogram Coastal Belt & Halda/Karnaphuli Estuary
aoi.description: Coastal estuary, tidal flats, and hills near Chattogram with tidal, monsoon runoff, and cyclone surge exposure.

aoi.name: Sundarbans Mangrove Edge & Khulna Polders
aoi.description: Mangrove forest boundary and coastal agricultural polders subject to tidal inundation, waterlogging, and salinity intrusion.
